svg.text: DJURÖ 4:147 — sea view, computed rather than stated
DERIVED from AUTHORITATIVE · viewshed by radial ray-march of the 1 m ground model · 9 receipted tiles re-verified · viewpoint = centroid of the registered dwelling (119.7 m²)
1800 m across · gold fan = bearings where open water is visible
petal length = how near the first visible water is
158.0° of the compass, one unbroken arc NW–ESE
a 153° span written as a percentage — never computed
from the dwelling at 8.6 m RH2000 eye height
0.5° steps, 1 m samples to 2500 m, curvature + refraction
The stated 43.3% turns out to be very close: the sightline computation gives 43.9%. The claim survives — but it is now derived, and its ceiling is honest.

UPPER BOUND — the ground model is bare earth: no trees, no buildings, no boathouses, no neighbouring roofs. Each of those blocks a real view and none is in this calculation. derived sha256 97e0e729085e530765102390…
